newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan falls to lowest level this year in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Nissan falls to lowest level this year in Tokyo.

text.p: Shares of Nissan Motor Co Ltd fell to their lowest level this year on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on Friday morning, traders said.

"Investors are continuing to sell Nissan shares and buy blue chips, such as Honda Motor Co Ltd and Toyota Motor Corp, which are expected to post favourable earnings," a trader at a second-tier brokerage said.
Nissan Motor was down 16 yen at 724 by midday. Turnover was 1.82 million shares.
Its previous low this year was 735 yen, marked on Thursday. Its closed at 740 on Thursday.
